summary: Moves the navigation arrow and map markers to follow the camera and the car.

writes: script fields offsetX/offsetZ, scene node transforms, marker records

One caller site. Arguments are read by the script-VM parser FUN_0045d910 and the wheel record is found through an int field of the script object (FUN_0042ab50).

summary: Returns whether the car has a horn sound loaded.
reads: car record 0x1dcc (selected horn index) and the sound table at car+0x1fbc + index*0x10 + 0x83c
notes: Descriptor says int; handler returns a bool (0 or 1). Chassis script object -> engine handle at +0xc -> game object (+0x44 car handle, +0x4c physics record) is resolved first via vtable calls and FUN_005447d0 (resource-state check).

summary: Returns the squared speed of the vehicle (x*x+y*y+z*z of its velocity).

notes: FUN_00426470 may call the script method getInfo or a vtable function; not fully read. Prints an error text (Mighty ERROR) and returns 0.0 when the field is missing. Arguments are read by the script-VM parser FUN_0045d910 and the wheel record is found through an int field of the script object (FUN_0042ab50).

summary: Returns the crime level of the vehicle, or -1 if it cannot be resolved.
notes: Name says hasCrime but it returns a float stored at 0x2104, not a yes/no. Returns -1.0 on failure. Chassis script object -> engine handle at +0xc -> game object (+0x44 car handle, +0x4c physics record) is resolved first via vtable calls and FUN_005447d0 (resource-state check).

summary: Builds the engine torque and horsepower tables from the engine's script variables.
reads: script variables by name (cylinders, stroke, RPM_limit, time_spark_min, rpm_turbo_mul, P_turbo_max, mixture_ratio, maxRPM, nitro_H and more); argument 1 float step
writes: dyno record fields; writes script fields Displacement, Compression, maxTorque, RPM_maxTorque, maxHP, RPM_maxHP, table_stepsize, torquetable, HPtable
notes: Many simulation helpers (FUN_004b6a80, FUN_004b69a0, FUN_004b77f0, FUN_004b68b0) not read. Always returns 0.0 although descriptor is F. If no dyno record exists it makes a temporary one and frees it. Checks that class java.lang.Native exists. Arguments are read by the script-VM parser FUN_0045d910 and the wheel record is found through an int field of the script object (FUN_0042ab50).

summary: Destroys the dyno record and zeroes the script object's field.

notes: Same code as getTorque with the other table (0x1e4). Arguments are read by the script-VM parser FUN_0045d910 and the wheel record is found through an int field of the script object (FUN_0042ab50).

summary: Returns the engine torque at a given RPM by linear interpolation of the dyno table.

notes: Returns 0.0 if rpm is negative or beyond the table. Third parsed value is unused. Arguments are read by the script-VM parser FUN_0045d910 and the wheel record is found through an int field of the script object (FUN_0042ab50).
